o: Season 2 sees the return of the heroic trio as these classroom pets live in a kindergarten in New York City and travel all around the globe in their amazing "Jetcar" to rescue animals in musical, mini-opera-themed adventures. When the going gets tough, Izzy, Tate and Zuri always remember to combine their talents and abilities and work together to save the day — because together, there's nothing…

eps.t: Help the Theater Mouse! / Save the Origami Bunny!
eps.o: A mouse learns there are no small parts in the play—even for small critters—and the trio constructs an origami boat for a paper bunny.

eps.t: Help Pizza Kitty! / Save the Tropical Fishie!
eps.o: The team learns that the perfect pizza is the one made with friends, and a little fish needs help getting to school on time.

eps.t: Save the Sleeping Cutie! / Help the Dress-Up Bear!
eps.o: The Wonder Pets must get a koala to bed before he sleepwalks into trouble, and the gang comes together to help a bear find the perfect outfit.

eps.t: Help the Wallabies! / Help the Slimy Slug!
eps.o: A baby kangaroo would rather stay in mama's pouch than venture outside, and a slimy slug seeks a game he can play with his friends.

eps.t: Here Comes Cousin Luca! / Help the Emperor Penguin... Fly!
eps.o: The trio becomes a quartet for the day when Zuri's cousin pays a visit, and an emperor penguin tries to conquer flying.

eps.t: Help the Blue Whale! / Help the Baby Meerkat!
eps.o: A blue whale deals with some bubble trouble, and the pets search the savanna to reunite a meerkat with his mom.

eps.t: Save the Fennec Fox! / Save the Giant Tortoise!
eps.o: A fennec fox is flustered by a noisy road, and the trio aids a tortoise whose world got flipped upside down—literally!

eps.t: Save the Coral! / Help the Queen Bee!
eps.o: It's all paws to the rescue when a coral reef is covered in garbage, and a newly crowned queen bee gives the team a buzz for some honey help.

eps.t: A Day at the Beach! / Save the Savanna Friends!
eps.o: The pets need help when a beach day goes awry, and a baby hippo faces a tough goodbye when her friend moves away.

eps.t: Help the Red Panda! / Help the Songbirds... Write a Song!
eps.o: Friends come together when a red panda's paper lantern rips, and songbirds look to the trio for musical inspiration.

eps.t: Help the Dancing Fishies! / Save the Red Balloon!
eps.o: The Wonder Pets bring harmony to an underwater dance battle, and a runaway balloon races through the city.
When a scarecrow isn't scary enough to fend off pumpkin-eating crows, the Wonder Pets have to save Halloween.

eps.t: Help the Holiday Hamster! / Save the Snowman!
eps.o: A hamster is too excited to sleep on Christmas Eve, and the trio smells trouble when a snowman's carrot nose goes missing.
